ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with sparse, high-intensity (white) point-source pixel clusters; ratio favors dark pixels by approximately 98:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment distribution; absence of large-scale white mottling; high-contrast white focal points localized at distal tips and scattered across central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central U-shaped notch; inner lobe convergence angle observed at approximately 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency micro-variations; prominent deep macro-indentation located on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Visible trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel patterns concentrated at the distal tips; individual circular motifs scattered across the central fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected across the dark surface pigment, with higher density on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss indentation on the left lobe's medial trailing edge; heavy barnacle encrustation present at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced and extensive rake mark patterns distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.
